units.source_text: 夜鸟啼鸣，从苇原岛明处腾空而飞。

en.t: Night birds cried out and rose into the air from the bright part of Ashihara Island.

units.source_text: 我感到父亲瘦骨嶙峋的手压在我肩膀上的分量。

en.t: I felt the weight of my father's bony hand pressing down on my shoulder.

units.source_text: 当我把视线落在这肩膀上时，由于月光的关系，我看到父亲的手正在变成白骨。

en.t: When I lowered my eyes to that shoulder, the moonlight made me see my father's hand turning into white bone.
